title: Welcome to Dulmeth's Journal
excerpt: Journal is now available. This is a read-only preview of recent updates from the summer garden.

title: Planting day
excerpt: Planted tomatoes and basil. Sunny afternoon — soil is warm and well-drained.

title: First bloom
excerpt: The first flower opened today — lovely color and a welcome sign of summer.

title: Light rain and growth
excerpt: A few light showers helped the seedlings grow taller. Leaves look healthy and green.

title: Early harvest
excerpt: Picked the first small tomatoes and some basil. Preparing a fresh salad tonight.
